note: Motifs boxed by hand in the works of data/curated.json. Boxes are fractions of each work's image (x0, y0, x1, y1). A motif is one thing a painter made out of ink: a fish, a swallow, a rock. Left out: Muqi's Dragon and Tiger (the silk is too dark to read the ink), Bodhidharma (line only), Chen Chun and Li Shan (too dense to separate one motif), Shitao's two Qinhuai leaves (line-led landscapes). Also left out after checking the crops: Huang Shen's trunk and Sotatsu's trunk (the boxes could not isolate them).
